name: Causeway: Fissure Ridge
summary: A Discord‑torn ridge where the Causeway’s upper terraces collapse into unstable fissures and arcane rifts.
description: Fissure Ridge is the most unstable elevation of the Causeway. The stone spine of the ridge has been split open by Discord eruptions, creating jagged chasms, arcane rifts, and corrupted Dragorn ruins. Muramite forces avoid the deepest fissures, leaving them to Discord manifestations and animated remnants of Dragorn ceremonial architecture. Resistance scouts use the ridge’s instability to strike from unpredictable angles, but the area is perilous even to them.
